value.title: First light: wire scan -> enrich -> query end-to-end
value.summary: The campfire plan: compose the landed parts (scanner, discovery, fs3-git, store API, config registry, providers) into one working system - scan a real codebase, enrich it, query it.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: "Everything exists as tested parts on main; this plan is WIRING, deliberately lean (Jordan: 'don't overbake it'). Add a root via the CLI -> daemon snapshots+enqueues -> job runner scans (pure scanner) -> enrichment jobs summarize+embed through the provider registry (fake in CI, Azure live) -> semantic search returns ranked hits in the workshop-004 envelope. Proof: fs3 indexes ITSELF and answers queries. Authorities: workshops 002 (schema, landed), 003 (query surface - v1 slice only), 004 (envelope - v1 slice only); daemon-worker-architecture.md incl. its queued decisions, two of which this plan settles small: retry = 3 attempts with not_before backoff; re-queue-while-running = accept reconciler latency."

sections.name: goals
value: One end-to-end path: add path -> scanned -> enriched -> searchable, all through the daemon (single writer, PRD 20).
Deterministic CI proof with the fake provider; recorded live run with Azure via the registry.
First slice of the query surface (semantic search + core filters) in the workshop-004 envelope with next_action/fix.
Idempotence: re-scanning an unchanged repo costs zero enrichment (content-addressing doing its job).

sections.name: non_goals
value: File watcher (daemon plan proper - doctrine locked, not wired here).
Conversations, text/regex modes, full filter set, MCP, doctor, docs get/list.
Concurrency combinator crate (inline semaphore/batching is enough for v1; combinator remains a roster row).
Cross-platform release/CI (reqs 46-48) and s002 phase-2 docker paving (parallel, ox).

value.claim: `flowspace3 add <path>` + `flowspace3 scan` against a real codebase yields elements, smart content, and embeddings rows via daemon-claimed jobs - CLI is a thin envelope client.
`flowspace3 search "<question>"` (semantic, --repo/--path/--limit/--min-score/--source raw|smart) returns ranked hits with addresses, spans, tags, match_field in the workshop-004 envelope.
A CI-runnable end-to-end test (fake provider, throwaway db) proves scan->enrich->search deterministically, incl. the idempotence claim: second scan of unchanged tree enqueues zero enrichment.

A recorded LIVE run: the daemon scans an ISOLATED FIXTURE SUBSET (crates/parsers/fixtures corpus - cheap, cents not dollars; Jordan 2026-08-26) through Azure (registry-selected) and answers 3 sample questions sensibly - transcript in plan assets.
Envelope v1 + error catalog seed live in fs3-core: ok/error shapes, FS3-E codes with mandatory fix, next_action - consumed by every new CLI verb and endpoint.

value.title: Wire and prove end-to-end
value.brief: One phase: envelope seed, daemon endpoints + job runner, enrichment through the registry, search v1, then the proof runs (CI-fake + live-Azure).

value.question: Scope discipline?
value.answer: Jordan: 'draft up the plan, but don't overbake it... a bit of a campfire for our next step' - lean wiring plan, one phase.

value.question: Retry/re-queue decisions?
value.answer: Settled small in-plan: 3 attempts + backoff; running-job changes ride the reconciler (daemon plan may revisit).

value.question: Search scope?
value.answer: Workshop 003 v1 slice: semantic only + 5 filters; text/regex/conversations later.

value.question: Schema rollforward during iteration?
value.answer: Jordan: doctor should patch/upgrade automatically (no second command); every db-accessing command does a quick schema check and rejects stale pointing at doctor; dogfood doctor from now. tk-0108.

value.notes: 3 clarifications; authorities are the landed workshops.
No new crates/ports; wiring in daemon/cli; arch check enforces.
1 phase, 7 tasks, 8 dw, 5 ACs all claimed.
CI-fake e2e + live recorded run; every dw runnable.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Authorities bind: workshops 002/003/004 + fs3-architecture.md; contradiction = stop-and-ask.
Only the daemon writes PG (PRD 20); the CLI never opens a pool.
Enrichment stays keyed by raw_hash (D2) - anything keyed by element id is drift.
Fake provider for all CI; keyed Azure only for the recorded live run.
Shared-tree commit discipline per ruling 2026-08-26 (file-scoped adds, push-first, scoped fmt).
